subtitle: Lesson 4 · AI and LLM Security Fundamentals

steps.label: API security
steps.sub: Auth, authz, rate-limiting, logging all still apply — the prompt itself now needs scrutiny

steps.label: Data classification
steps.sub: Now extends to training data and whatever retrieval feeds into the model's context

steps.label: Supply chain security
steps.sub: Models, checkpoints, datasets, and plugins — same provenance discipline, new sources

steps.label: Identity & access control
steps.sub: Least privilege for agents: scoped, time-limited permissions, like any service account

code:
# The discipline you already know STAYS the discipline.
# What's new is the SURFACE it now has to cover:
#
#   API security      -> the prompt/response payload
#   Data classification -> training + retrieval pipelines
#   Supply chain       -> models, checkpoints, plugins
#   Access control     -> the agent's own credentials
#
# Plus a focused set of genuinely new concerns:
# prompt injection, output handling, training data
# integrity, and agent autonomy.
caption: AI security engineering = your existing disciplines, scoped wider, plus this short new list.

subtitle: You now have the vocabulary — next, the defenses.
